Summary.en: Adds Matomo (Piwik) analytics tracking to the form.
Summary.it: Aggiunge il tracciamento analitico Matomo (Piwik) al modulo.

Parameter.SiteID: The ID of the Matomo-Project-Site that shall be used for tracking.
Parameter.URL: The URL of the Matomo-Server that shall track the tagged form.
Parameter.ImageURL: The URL of the Matomo image to use for tracking.

SiteID.default: The ID of the Matomo-Project-Site that shall be used for tracking.

URL.default: The URL of the Matomo-Server that shall track the tagged form.

ImageURL.default: The URL of the Matomo image to use for tracking.
